note: White, or they were, they have gone slightly cream with age. A wash down and they are perfectly usable, and they stack. Knock loudly, the bell has never worked.

title: Six terracotta plant pots
note: Mixed sizes from about 10cm up to 25cm, all with drainage holes. Two have chalky white marks from our hard water. Out from about four, take it whenever suits.

title: Seed trays and a bag of plant labels
note: Two trays plus a good handful of plastic labels. Some labels are written on in pencil, which rubs off. If it rains I will move it into the hallway, just knock.

title: Retro style FM radio
note: Runs on mains or batteries, though there are no batteries with it. Warm sound, and a small scuff on the leather effect covering. Parking is single yellow outside so it is quicker on foot.

title: Canvas wardrobe, zip front
note: Metal frame with a fabric cover, takes about ten minutes to put up. One zip pull is missing so you need a paperclip on that side. The gate is stiff, give it a firm shove.

title: Portable radio with a carry handle
note: Analogue tuning, takes D batteries, good for a shed or the garden. The telescopic aerial is complete and straight. The dog barks at the door but he is shut in the kitchen.

title: Three gravel trays
note: Standard seed tray size with no drainage holes, for standing pots on. Some soil staining that will not scrub out. Please text before setting off so it is not a wasted trip.

title: Vintage brass desk lamp
note: Heavy base with a green glass shade, rewired with a new plug. Chip on the underside rim of the shade. In the porch behind the recycling boxes.

title: Height adjustable homework desk
note: Took our two through primary school and the height adjustment still works. Stickers on the underside that mostly peel off. Left in the shared lobby, first door on the right.

title: Spider plant with babies
note: Grown on from one my mum gave me years ago, and there are plenty of runners on it. In a plastic pot, and the leaf tips are brown on a few. Awkward shape rather than heavy, one person can manage.

title: Russell Hobbs kettle, 1.7 litres
note: Boils quickly and was descaled last week. The lid button sticks unless you press it square on. Bring something to wrap it in, it is a bit dusty.

title: Large blue glazed pot
note: About 40cm across with a matching saucer, and no cracks anywhere. Heavy empty and extremely heavy full, worth knowing. On the porch shelf so it stays dry.

title: Modular seed cells, forty modules
note: Four trays worth of reusable cells, washed and stacked. A couple of cells have splits in them. The buzzer is the top button and it sticks a little.

title: Kallax shelving unit, two by four
note: White, out of the spare room, and the frame is straight and true. Two of the eight sections have pen marks inside and there are no inserts or boxes. I work from home so any time before seven is fine.

title: Toaster with wide bagel slots
note: Takes thick bread and bagels without a fight. One side runs slightly darker than the other, you learn to allow for it. Basement flat, and the steps down are steep.

title: Bunch of ripe bananas
note: Five bananas, spotty rather than black. Good for eating today or for banana bread tomorrow. In a cool bag by the door, buzz and I will bring it out.

title: IKEA MALM chest, four drawers
note: Black brown, and it comes with the wall anchor strap still in its bag. One drawer front has a chip near the handle. By the front door under a bin bag to keep it dry.

title: Wooden play kitchen with a clock
note: Turning clock hands, a chalkboard on the door and a proper handle. The chalkboard is worn pale in the middle. It folds down small enough for the bus, we have done it.

title: Six apples and four pears
note: From a friends garden, so a few have bruises and marks on them. Fine for eating or for stewing down. Kept in the fridge until you say you are on your way.

title: IKEA LACK side table, black
note: The small square one, handy as a plant stand or a bedside table. One corner is dented and there is a ring stain on top. Left in the lobby with a note on it so nobody moves it.

title: Low slatted coffee table
note: Made from scaffold boards so it is heavier than it looks. Splinters on one end that a bit of sanding would fix. Please shut the gate behind you, the cat gets out.

title: Peace lily that needs repotting
note: Root bound, so it droops if you forget it and then perks up within an hour. Still in its nursery pot. Easier to carry with two, it is more bulky than heavy.

title: Two slice toaster, cream
note: Browns evenly and the crumb tray slides out for cleaning. The reheat button does nothing any more, everything else works. Out on the step in a bag for life.

title: Set of four soft dinosaurs
note: Green and orange, no sound boxes, good for a toddler. One tail has a small hole where the stuffing peeks out. Knock at the side door, we never hear the front.

title: Double buggy, side by side
note: Both seats recline independently and the brakes hold well. It is wide, so measure your front door before you commit. Buzz and I will bring it down to the entrance.

title: Wicker armchair with cushion
note: Indoor conservatory type, light enough to carry on your own. One strand of wicker has come loose at the base and the cushion is faded on one side. Come to the porch, the light is on a sensor.

title: Tomatoes, a punnet and a half
note: On the vine, and a couple have split skins. Best cooked down into a sauce. Message when you are close and I will bring it to the door.

title: Three small bunny soft toys
note: Washed last week and dried properly. One has a loose ear seam that wants a couple of stitches. Behind the front gate, just push it open.

title: Four slice stainless toaster
note: All four slots work at the same rate and the crumb trays are clean. Scratch along one side of the casing. Ring the bell for flat B and I will bring it out.

title: Maclaren buggy, navy
note: Folds down small and the rain cover is included. One wheel squeaks and the hood has a small tear along a seam. Left inside the porch, the outer door is unlocked.

title: Small DAB kitchen radio
note: Mains powered, with an aerial that extends, and it picks up everything from our kitchen. One preset button is stiff. In the lobby by the post boxes, the door is on the latch until six.

title: Corner desk, beech effect
note: L shaped, and it splits into two halves for carrying. The keyboard tray still slides but one runner squeaks. Buzz flat 3 and I will come down with it.

title: Sliced white tin loaf
note: Bought by mistake, we meant to pick up wholemeal. The bag is sealed and nothing is missing. On the step in a box, better collected sooner than later.

title: Standard lamp with a fringed shade
note: Old fashioned looking, but it was rewired last year and works perfectly. The shade is dusty, the fringe is all there. By the bins to the left of the front door.

title: Rattan effect garden chair
note: Single chair with a washable cushion cover. There is a watermark on the back of the cushion. Tucked under the bay window, out of the rain.

title: Root trainers for beans and sweet peas
note: Deep cells that hinge open so the roots come out undisturbed. Complete with the frame, and used for one season only. Message when you are outside and I will pop it out.

title: Narrow bookcase, dark stain
note: Only 40cm wide so it fits in an alcove. The veneer is lifting slightly on the top edge but you would have to look for it. It is behind the gate, mind the step down.

title: Ten oranges
note: Bought a crate at the market and got carried away. Thick skinned, so a bit of work to peel, but good for juicing. Ring the bell, it stays in the fridge until then.

title: Booster seat for a dining chair
note: Straps onto a normal chair and has its own little tray. The plastic is stained orange from tomato sauce. Round the side by the wheelie bins.

title: Full size garden spade
note: The head is straight with no bends and it has done a lot of real work. Small split near the top of the wooden shaft that is still sound. On the step in a box, please take the box as well.

title: Mustard armchair, teak legs
note: Reupholstered a few years back and the frame is still solid. Small burn mark on the seat near the front edge. Heavy, so bring a friend and something to carry it in.

title: Three wheel pushchair with a basket
note: Reclines flat for a nap and the basket underneath is a decent size. Tyres need air and there is a hole in one corner of the basket. It will not fit in a car boot, you would want a van.

title: Single bentwood cafe chair
note: Dark stain, no wobble at all, good at a desk or a small table. The cane seat has frayed a little at the front edge. Comes apart flat if you bring an allen key.

title: Wooden toy kitchen
note: Hob, an opening oven door and a plastic sink that lifts out. Two of the knobs are missing and there are pen marks down one side. Best collected before dark, the hallway light is out.
